verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents two related controls, but neither is a reusable browser profile that keeps login state across requests. The `cookies` parameter only lets the user pass custom cookies on each call, which is a manual workaround. The `session_id` parameter only routes multiple requests through the same IP address, which is IP stickiness rather than a stored browser profile. There is no evidence of server-side profile or cookie-jar persistence, so neither control earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse a persistent browser profile with saved cookies and login state across multiple requests

citations.quote: Pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape
Route multiple API requests through the same IP address
